scope: Native 13-authored-shape candidate; four settled shapes only, not default 60/full OS input/16GB/power/GPU utilization or eight-hour app soak
machine: Apple M5 32 GiB arm64 macOS, actual run to record OS build

body.fixture: same count/code-defined seed and character template per native app

candidateSelection: After source returns; record exact BuildInfo/SHA and strict ad-hoc verification before launch; no choose after resource result
attribution: Explicit main PID/start_abstime/coalition identity; native single process. No automatic global process discovery or other-app private data. Actual show/shape/pause/hide/reopen/quit observed by root CUA. Counter is draw submission, not presentation FPS.
quiet: Pause root/agent builds and tests while sampling; do not close unrelated user apps. Existing R5 offscreen soak may run concurrently and is an explicit condition, not counted in candidate PID footprint/CPU. Record its identity and completion time.

reporting.cpu: Native helper user+system deltas divided by Mach monotonic elapsed; 100 percent means one logical core
reporting.memory: charged footprint and resident bytes separately, byte-to-MiB exact; not system unique RAM
reporting.validation: Existing v2 numeric validator preserved as source reference; v3 copy changes only renderer expected name; every phase explicit body/shape/uniform bytes from frozen BuildInfo/source. Never fix thresholds after seeing values; FAIL retained.
reporting.causalComparison: Old v2 sphere run differs in time/session/fixture and source; descriptive only, not isolated backend or 13-vs60 effect
